page.layout: One printed page, title page. A decorative woodcut border across the top; below it the dedication block centred in several lines of varying type sizes, ending with a signature line in black letter at the lower right. No running head, no page number, no margins with text.
page.notes: The signature "Falck." is printed in black letter (Fraktur) and is transcribed here as printed. Decorative woodcut border at the top is not text. Scan shows scattered specks and stains, not transcribed. The first line's "ILLUSTRI" and "EXCELLENTIS" are set in spaced italic capitals; the hyphen after EXCELLENTIS-/SIMO is printed.
